title: Cleft Sentences
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Las Cleft Sentences son la herramienta de énfasis más sofisticada del inglés. Usarlas correctamente te permitirá resaltar exactamente la información que quieres que tu audiencia recuerde, ya sea en discursos, presentaciones o correos formales.

parts.visual:
Las Cleft Sentences se usan para dar énfasis a una parte específica de una oración. Es como poner esa información 'bajo un foco'. 
1. It-Cleft (IT + BE + elemento enfatizado + THAT/WHO): 
Normal: John signed the contract. (Hecho neutro). 
Cleft (énfasis en quién): IT WAS JOHN WHO signed the contract. (Fue JOHN quien firmó). 
Cleft (énfasis en qué): IT WAS THE CONTRACT THAT John signed. (Fue EL CONTRATO lo que John firmó).
parts.audio: Cleft Sentences are used to give emphasis to a specific part of a sentence. It is like putting that information under a spotlight. The first type is the It-Cleft. Structure: It, plus Be, plus the emphasized element, plus 'that' or 'who'. Normal sentence: John signed the contract. Cleft with emphasis on WHO: It was John who signed the contract. Cleft with emphasis on WHAT: It was the contract that John signed.

parts.visual:
2. What-Cleft (WHAT + sujeto + verbo + IS/WAS + el énfasis): 
La cláusula con 'What' actúa como sujeto. Es muy formal y contundente. 
Normal: I need more time to finish this. 
Cleft: WHAT I NEED IS more time to finish this. (Lo que necesito ES más tiempo). 
Normal: He wants a promotion. 
Cleft: WHAT HE WANTS IS a promotion. (Lo que él quiere ES un ascenso).
parts.audio: The second type is the What-Cleft. Structure: What, plus subject, plus verb, plus Is or Was, plus the emphasis. The 'What' clause acts as the subject. It is very formal and emphatic. Normal sentence: I need more time to finish this. Cleft: What I need is more time to finish this. Normal: He wants a promotion. Cleft: What he wants is a promotion.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la Cleft Sentence correcta según el tipo (It-Cleft o What-Cleft).

questions.question: Normal: Sarah submitted the report. -> It was Sarah ____ submitted the report. (Énfasis en QUIÉN).
questions.explanation: It-Cleft con persona: It was Sarah WHO submitted...

questions.question: Normal: I need your support right now. -> ____ I need is your support right now. (What-Cleft).
Normal: The board approved the merger. -> It was the merger ____ the board approved. (Énfasis en QUÉ - cosa).
questions.explanation: It-Cleft con cosa (merger): It was the merger THAT the board approved.

questions.question: Normal: The client wants a 20% discount. -> What the client ____ is a 20% discount. (What-Cleft).
questions.explanation: What the client wants is... (tiempo presente del verbo).

questions.question: Normal: The CEO fired him last Tuesday. -> It was last Tuesday ____ the CEO fired him. (Énfasis en CUÁNDO).
questions.explanation: Para énfasis en tiempo/lugar/cosa siempre usamos THAT en It-Cleft.

questions.question: Normal: We need to cut costs, not raise prices. -> What we need to do is ____ costs, not raise prices. (Reducir).
questions.explanation: What... is + infinitivo sin 'to'. What we need to do is CUT costs.

questions.question: Normal: The director resigned because of the scandal. -> It was the scandal ____ caused the director to resign. (Énfasis en la CAUSA).
questions.explanation: It was the scandal THAT caused...

questions.question: Normal: He really wants recognition, not money. -> What he really ____ is recognition, not money.
questions.explanation: What he really wants is recognition.

questions.question: Normal: The London office received the package. -> It was the London office ____ received the package.
questions.explanation: Office = cosa, lugar: It was the London office THAT received...

questions.question: Normal: The team solved the problem. -> It was the team ____ solved the problem. (El equipo = un grupo de personas).
questions.explanation: Para grupos/objetos se puede usar THAT. It was the team THAT solved it.

questions.question: Normal: She called me, not my assistant. -> It was ____ she called, not my assistant.
questions.explanation: It was ME she called. (pronombre objeto).

questions.question: Normal: The company really needs a new strategy. -> What the company really needs ____ a new strategy.
questions.explanation: What + singular subject + verb + IS... (verbo SER en singular).

questions.question: Normal: They launched the product in January. -> It was in January ____ they launched the product.
questions.explanation: Para tiempo y lugar en It-Cleft: THAT.

questions.question: Normal: I find the lack of communication frustrating. -> What I find frustrating ____ the lack of communication.
questions.explanation: What I find frustrating IS... (el verbo ser debe concordar con el sujeto real).

questions.question: Normal: He destroyed the company with his ego. -> It was his ego ____ destroyed the company.
questions.explanation: It was his ego THAT destroyed...

questions.question: Normal: We should focus on quality, not speed. -> What we should focus on ____ quality, not speed.
questions.explanation: What we should focus on IS quality...

questions.question: Normal: The new regulation caused the delays. -> It was the new regulation ____ caused the delays.
questions.explanation: It was the new regulation THAT caused...

questions.question: Normal: I like the honesty of this team. -> What I ____ about this team is their honesty.
questions.explanation: What I like about... (sujeto yo = like).

questions.question: Normal: Tom invented this algorithm. -> It was Tom ____ invented this algorithm.
Normal: The investors need transparency. -> What the investors need ____ transparency.
questions.explanation: What the investors need IS transparency.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra que falta para completar la Cleft Sentence.

questions.question: It was John ____ called. (Quién - persona)
It was the contract ____ we signed. (Que - cosa)
____ I need is more time. (Lo que - What-Cleft)
What she wants ____ a promotion. (Verbo ser)
It was in March ____ they launched. (Tiempo)
What we need to do is ____ costs. (Cut - sin to)
It was ____ ego that ruined it. (Su - His)
What I like about you ____ your honesty. (Verbo ser)
It was the CEO ____ approved it. (Persona)
____ bothers me is the lack of respect. (Lo que - What-Cleft)

pairs.target: It was John WHO signed it.
It was the contract THAT was signed.
What I need is more time.
What she wants is a promotion.
It was in January that they launched.
What we should do is cut costs.
It was his ego that destroyed the company.
What I like about them is their honesty.
It was the scandal that caused it.
